title: Progression guide
summary: The path through SkyBlock, from your Private Island to the Slayers: which island to visit next, which skill levels open the way, and what to build and buy at each stage.

s.x: gather, unlock, craft, earn, go further.

There is no single route, and this page lays out one in six stages: what to gather, which gates open and what to aim for. The levels are the ones the game itself checks: the skill levels on the launch pads, the SkyBlock Level that opens the Bazaar and the Combat levels the slayer tiers need. Everything else is a rough guide.
